prompt: The client wants to know whether its quality problem is linked to higher output. Which takeaway matters most?

options.text: Defects tripled while output barely moved
options.feedback: Right. Defects went from 2% to 6% while output moved only between 50k and 53k.

options.text: Defects rose in step with output
options.feedback: On two axes the lines can look linked, but output barely moved (50k to 53k) while defects tripled.

options.text: Output reached a high of 53k units in April
options.feedback: True, but output moved only 6%. It doesn't answer whether higher output explains the defects.

options.text: Faulty supplier parts caused the defects
options.feedback: The chart shows defects rising, not why. That may be true, but nothing here supports it.

explanation: Defects went from 2% to 6% while output moved only between 50k and 53k.

extras.proof: Defects went from 2% to 6% while output moved only between 50k and 53k.
